args.title: Issue 4410: change src/config.ts
args.body:
File: src/config.ts

The src/config.ts file defines tokenTtlMinutes as an integer environment variable with the int() function that parses only integers and throws errors if not parsed correctly. The issue arises because TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES is set to '12h', which is not an integer, causing it to be incorrectly interpreted as 12, explaining why the token expires after about 12 minutes instead of 12 hours.

src/api/health.ts handles the /api/v1/health endpoint and its response status logic. It sets HTTP 200 when status is 'degraded', causing the load balancer probe to treat degraded as healthy, which mismatches expectations described in the issue.

args.title: Issue 4423: change src/i18n/index.ts
args.body:
File: src/i18n/index.ts

The function pickLocale in src/i18n/index.ts parses the Accept-Language header but ignores the quality values (q) and always picks the first supported language by order. This behavior causes higher weighted languages to be ignored, explaining why French responses are not preferred despite the higher q value.
